description:
Recording ignores repeated, composing, and consumed recording shortcuts. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. The voice button should be enabled.
2. Dispatch three record-audio keydowns on the document that recording must ignore, in one eval: "(() => { const o = {key: 'M', code: 'KeyM', ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true}; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {...o, repeat: true})); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {...o, isComposing: true})); const consumed = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', o); consumed.preventDefault(); document.dispatchEvent(consumed); return 'dispatched'; })()".
3. The voice button should be enabled, and window.__recordingMock.microphoneRequests must be 0.
4. Press the record-audio shortcut. The recording panel should get data-mode "microphone".
5. Click the cancel button.
